Calculate what was asked by utilizing the line items clearly shown in the P&L statement and the cash flow statement.
model_answer:
Walmart's FY2018–FY2020 three‑year average unadjusted EBITDA margin was 6.2%. 

I computed unadjusted EBITDA as Operating income + Depreciation & amortization and used consolidated Net sales as the denominator. The inputs were: 2020 Operating income $20,568 + D&A $10,987 on Net sales $519,926; 2019 Operating income $21,957 + D&A $10,678 on Net sales $510,329; 2018 Operating income $20,437 + D&A $10,529 on Net sales $495,761, yielding annual margins ≈6.07%, 6.39% and 6.25% and a simple average of 6.24% (reported as 6.2% rounded). 

These source numbers appear in the filing tables under "Operating income", "Depreciation and amortization" and "Net sales" (e.g., "Operating income $20,568", "Depreciation and amortization 10,987", "Net sales $519,926").
